reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

title.narrative: ICLEI - Local governments for Sustainability, South Asia

description.narrative: In Kochi, Kerala, neglected canals have become toxic, endangering health, livelihoods, and flood resilience. Extreme flooding underscored the need for urgent action. Backed by Swiss Re Foundation, ICLEI South Asia, and bechtel.org, the Kochi Municipal Corporation is implementing a green-grey infrastructure approach that integrates nature-based solutions for waterway restoration. With a blueprint ready, catalytic funding is essential to pilot this model—paving the way for India’s first nature-based municipal bond to drive sustainable, climate-resilient urban water management
